themes.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — light register, #ffffff pageBackground, all #000000 text/links/nav (minimal monochrome). Added cube face surface tokens: surface-light #f5f5f5 (top), surface-mid #e0e0e0 (front), surface-dark #1a1a1a (side/footer).

Replaced source fonts with: Rajdhani (display/headings/buttons/nav, wght 400;500;600;700), Inter (body/p/links, wght 300;400;500;600), IBM Plex Mono (code/mono/labels, wght 400;500). All via Google Fonts CDN. Rajdhani condensed geometry suits isometric grid register. Letter-spacing 0em on h1/h2 (Rajdhani condensed — negative tracking over-tightens), +0.02em on h3/h4, +0.08em uppercase on buttons/labels. Body 16px/1.5 lineheight.

Added 4 isometric keyframes on top of hermes base: isoSlideIn (400ms, cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)) — translateX(-30px) translateY(-15px) rotateX(5deg) → 0; isoBobble (3600ms, ease-in-out, infinite) — subtle 4px y-axis float with 1.5deg rotateX peak; isoAssemble (200ms, linear) — opacity/translateY(8px) → 0 for staggered sequential builds; isoDepthPop (400ms, cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)) — scale(0.95) perspective translateZ(-20px) → full scale. CSS utility classes: .iso-slide-in, .iso-bobble, .iso-assemble, .iso-depth-pop, .iso-stagger-1 through 6. Easing tokens: --iso-easing-crisp: cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), --iso-easing-float: ease-in-out.

Staggered Isometric Column Offset. Added iso-specific tokens: --iso-grid: repeat(3, 1fr), --iso-offset: 24px, --iso-gutter: 48px, --iso-depth: 16px. 12-column base grid (--grid-columns: 12), 1440px container, 48px paddingInline. Responsive: tablet 2-col iso offset 12px, mobile 1-col no offset. .iso-grid, .iso-row--staggered (translateX 24px), .iso-depth-offset (translateY -16px) utility classes.

8px grid snap applied to all values. Added isometric perspective tokens: --spacing-iso-depth: 8px, --spacing-iso-face-height: 64px, --spacing-iso-offset-x: 40px, --spacing-iso-offset-y: 20px (2:1 ratio for isometric perspective). Button border-radius: 0px (hard isometric geometry). Clean 8px scale: xs 8px, sm 16px, md 24px, lg 40px, xl 64px, 2xl 80px, 3xl 96px.

Isometric axis interactions. Buttons hover: translateY(-2px) translateX(1px) + box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px #000000 (hard flat offset). Buttons active: translateY(1px) translateX(-1px) + box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #000000. Cards hover: translate(-3px, -3px) + box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15). Inputs focus: borderWidth 2px + box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #000000. All transitions: cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) at 180-200ms, no bounce.

Technical blueprint nav. Default: transparent background, 2px solid #000000 borderBottom. Scrolled: #ffffff background, same 2px border (no backdrop filter). Links: inherit fontFamily, 0.6875rem, uppercase, 0.1em letterSpacing. Link hover: textShadow 1px 1px 0 #000000 (hard 3D letter-lift), transition step-end (instant mechanical snap).

Full Isometric override. concept_by_image.md: axonometric projection at 30°, cube face hierarchy (top/front/side planes encoding depth), hard offset shadows as structural information, flat-coloured planes (no gradients), technical annotation section, color as three-register plane system. concept_by_video.md: 3 video placements — iso-city.mp4 (hero 12s, slow rotation/bob), iso-assembly.mp4 (features 6s, cube faces assembling step-by-step), iso-wireframe.mp4 (editorial 8s, rotating wireframe grid).
